assumptions.statement: The approved 2024–2035 corridor regulatory-plan page is public, but its statutory attachment returned HTTP 404 on 2026-08-22. Parcel controls, FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, daylight, fire access, and facility obligations remain unknown.
assumptions.statement_zh: 2024—2035 年获批控规公开页已经发布，但法定附件截至 2026-08-22 仍返回 404；地块控制、容积率、高度、密度、退线、道路红线、日照、消防和设施义务均不得推断。
assumptions.impact: All building envelopes, land-use support bands, roads, and implementation actions are conceptual recommendations, not statutory conclusions.
assumptions.mitigation: Use reversible typologies, avoid invented control numbers, and retain an explicit professional-verification gate before any project approval or engineering use.
assumptions.release_trigger: Valid approved-plan attachments and project-specific professional review are obtained.

assumptions.statement: The overall-design and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional geometry inferred from public descriptions.
assumptions.statement_zh: 总体设计范围和三处重点区采用主办仓库维护的临时粗略边界，仅由公开文字推断。
assumptions.impact: Area, ratio, clipping, and spatial-distribution results are low-confidence design-model values and cannot be represented as official redlines.
assumptions.mitigation: Lock the provided geometry unchanged, label it on every relevant drawing, and regenerate all derived layers when cleared official geometry becomes available.
assumptions.release_trigger: Organizer supplies cleared official GIS/CAD boundaries.

assumptions.statement: Official July–August 2026 reports describe Phase II as approaching opening and a future approximately nine-kilometre connected green corridor; exact as-built limits, acceptance, hours, and facility consistency are not published.
assumptions.statement_zh: 2026 年 7—8 月官方报道对二期使用“近期开园”和未来约 9 公里绿廊口径；竣工边界、验收、开放时段和设施一致性尚未公开。
assumptions.impact: The proposal treats the park as an emerging common-ground backbone and does not claim every segment is already fully operational.
assumptions.mitigation: Complete a segment-by-segment walk audit and authority confirmation before locating permanent entrances or operations.
assumptions.release_trigger: As-built map, acceptance status, and field survey are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: No cleared building-footprint survey, ownership ledger, vacancy record, structural assessment, or hazardous-material survey is available for the submission area.
assumptions.statement_zh: 投稿资料未提供可公开使用的建筑测绘、权属、空置、结构安全或有害材料调查。
assumptions.impact: Nine building envelopes are typology demonstrators only; no demolition, retention, floor area, or reuse quantity is asserted for a real parcel.
assumptions.mitigation: Prioritise reversible fit-outs and require building-by-building retain/repair/replace decisions after survey.
assumptions.release_trigger: Cleared survey, ownership, structural, and reuse audit are completed.

assumptions.statement: Official road centre lines, road redlines, rail and station interfaces, public-transport operations, crossing-control data, traffic counts, and barrier-free audits are absent.
assumptions.statement_zh: 尚缺道路中线与红线、铁路及站点接口、公交运营、过街控制、交通量和无障碍审计等权威资料。
assumptions.impact: Submitted routes are design connections and access principles, not approved road engineering or verified travel-time claims.
assumptions.mitigation: Use no-regret pedestrian-priority links and verify each crossing, loading route, emergency route, and universal-access chain before implementation.
assumptions.release_trigger: Transport authority data and field accessibility audit are completed.

assumptions.statement: The submission package does not include precise heritage-object locations, protection boundaries, construction-control zones, archaeological requirements, or conservation-condition surveys.
assumptions.statement_zh: 投稿资料未提供精确遗产点位、保护范围、建设控制地带、考古要求和保存状况调查。
assumptions.impact: Railway-memory elements are interpreted through reversible public-space protocols; no intervention into protected fabric is authorised.
assumptions.mitigation: Apply a no-touch default around unverified heritage and obtain conservation approval before excavation, attachment, lighting, or structural work.
assumptions.release_trigger: Authoritative heritage inventory and conservation review are obtained.

assumptions.statement: Utility alignments and capacities, energy and cooling loads, drainage, flood risk, tree survey, soil condition, fire water, communications, and construction staging constraints are not available.
assumptions.statement_zh: 尚缺市政管线与容量、能源与冷却负荷、排水防涝、树木、土壤、消防供水、通信和施工组织约束。
assumptions.impact: Shared infrastructure and climate-resilience proposals are performance intentions, not engineering capacity commitments.
assumptions.mitigation: Start with metered pilots, preserve access for maintenance, and require utility, arboricultural, geotechnical, drainage, and fire-engineering review.
assumptions.release_trigger: Relevant engineering surveys and capacity confirmations are complete.

assumptions.statement: No operator, land contributor, budget, procurement route, insurance arrangement, approval timetable, or revenue agreement has been appointed for the three proposed stations.
assumptions.statement_zh: 三个站点所提运营安排尚无获任命的运营主体、土地出资方、预算、采购、保险、审批时序或收益协议。
assumptions.impact: The operating charter, public-value return, and phased programme are recommended governance prototypes rather than commitments by named institutions.
assumptions.mitigation: Use a 100-day charter with a named owner, an ordinary public-service baseline, a cost ceiling, a stop rule, maintenance duty, and open evaluation before scale-up.
assumptions.release_trigger: Participating institutions sign a site-specific charter and funding/approval plan.

assumptions.statement: Green-space ratio, public-space ratio, prototype footprint, pilot area, and design-path length are recomputed from submitted conceptual GeoJSON clipped by provisional boundaries.
assumptions.statement_zh: 绿地率、公共空间率、原型建筑基底、试点面积和设计路径长度均由临时边界内的概念 GeoJSON 复算。
assumptions.impact: These values demonstrate internal consistency only; they are not surveyed existing-condition statistics or approved planning indicators. Productive-interface area/frontage, FAR, height, accessible-entry count, and reuse ratio remain unknown.
assumptions.mitigation: Keep formulas, CRS, geometry IDs, and unknown reasons machine-readable; regenerate metrics after authoritative data replacement.
assumptions.release_trigger: Official geometry and professional datasets replace provisional inputs and the review script passes again.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios are untested design hypotheses. Technology necessity, model fitness, privacy impact, bias, cybersecurity, accessibility, human accountability, manual fallback, incident response, and decommissioning have not been certified.
assumptions.statement_zh: AI 场景仍是未经实地验证的设计假设；技术必要性、模型适配、隐私、偏差、网络安全、无障碍、人工责任、手动兜底、事故响应和退役均未获认证。
assumptions.impact: No scenario may bypass human review or essential non-digital service. Public space remains usable when the AI layer is off.
assumptions.mitigation: Require a necessity test, minimal data, consent where applicable, visible human contact, continuity of ordinary service, red-team review, logs, complaint route, stop threshold, and deletion/decommissioning plan.
assumptions.release_trigger: A site-specific public-interest and safety review approves a bounded pilot.

assumptions.statement: The package intentionally embeds agent-generated graphics, repository-provided geometry, and one reduced Noto Sans SC font subset redistributed under SIL Open Font License 1.1; external official and case-study pages remain text citations, not redistributed media.
assumptions.statement_zh: 投稿包嵌入智能体原创图形、仓库提供的几何，以及一个按 SIL Open Font License 1.1 再分发的 Noto Sans SC 精简字体子集；外部官方资料及案例仍只作文字引用，不转载其图片或版式。
assumptions.impact: No third-party photograph, remote tile, remote or uncleared font, logo, or executable remote dependency is required to review the package offline.
assumptions.mitigation: Maintain sources.json, copyright_statement.md, manifest hashes, the embedded OFL notice, offline checks, and a final asset inventory before publication.
assumptions.release_trigger: Final rights inventory and repository publication review pass.
